name: Dark Memory
text: Agnes Baker deck only. Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - If Dark Memory is in your hand at the end of your turn, reveal it and take 2 horror.
text_cn: 阿格尼丝·贝克牌组专用。 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。（此效果可能导致当前密谋推进。） 强制 - 如果你回合结束时手牌中有黑暗记忆：展示该牌并受到2点恐惧。
